slides.author: Alexey Grigorev
slides.title: Build a deployable agent first
slides.subtitle: Make the full path work before adding more agent features.

slides.title: Start with the path
slides.body: The first milestone is not a perfect agent. It is a working path from question to backend, frontend, container, and deployment.

slides.title: Keep version one small
slides.body: A simple tool loop is enough for the first slice. Add memory, vector search, and structured outputs after the deployed version works.

slides.title: Streaming adds complexity
slides.body: Structured outputs are useful, but combining them with streaming and tool events can make the first version harder to reason about.

slides.title: Then improve the system
slides.body: Once the vertical slice runs, add traces, tests, retrieval improvements, auth, and evaluation against a real workflow.
